name: Kenaz
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Caleb offers Achsah his daughter to wife to whoever smites Kirjath-sepher, and Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, takes it. Achsah asks her father for a blessing, springs of water with the south land, and Caleb gives her the upper springs and the nether springs.

note.label: Judges 1: Judah Goes Up First, but the Inhabitants Are Not Driven Out

points: The Most High delivered Chushan-rishathaim into Othniel's hand, and the land had rest forty years, until Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

note.label: Judges 3: Nations Left to Prove Israel

points: The families of Judah are traced further through Chelub, Kenaz, Othniel, and the sons of Ezra and their households.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 4: The Families of Judah and Simeon
